headline: AI data center ambitions in Hai Phong: three questions for the big players BTCT, NTC and SGP
summary: A planned AI data center in Hai Phong, Vietnam, has a capacity of 300 MW. The project is described as among the most notable digital infrastructure stories in the country.
why: Large AI data centers drive demand for power, semiconductors and cloud infrastructure, and they attract capital from technology and utility companies.
